import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, cpSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { sandbox } from "../test/fixtures";
import { updateState, journal, snooze } from "../src/state";
import { writeJson } from "../src/fsutil";
import { writeCache } from "../src/inbox";

const out = process.argv[2]!;
const sb = sandbox();
const ctx = sb.ctx;
let t = 1767225600000;
Date.now = () => (t += 1000);
mkdirSync(ctx.stateDir, { recursive: true });

// state.json: unknown field first, then typed updates incl. delete+re-add
writeFileSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "state.json"), JSON.stringify({ futureThing: { a: [1, 2], b: "<x>&" }, lastSeen: 5 }, null, 2) + "\n");
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.lastTidy = Date.now(); s.tidyErrors = [{ step: "links", message: "boom <1> &   é", at: Date.now() }]; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.exports["zed"] = { at: Date.now(), ok: true }; s.exports["alpha"] = { at: Date.now(), ok: false, error: "no \"tool\"\nfound" }; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.notify = { key: "k", at: Date.now() }; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.blocked = { reason: "plaintext", at: Date.now() }; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.unpack = { profile: "workstation", hash: "abc123", at: Date.now() }; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.lastSync = Date.now(); });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.lastAutosave = Date.now(); });
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "state.json"), join(out, "state-full.json"));
updateState(ctx, (s) => { delete s.notify; });
updateState(ctx, (s) => { s.notify = { key: "k2", at: Date.now() }; delete s.blocked; });
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "state.json"), join(out, "state-readd.json"));

// minimal: nothing on disk, then a lastSeen update
sb.cleanup;
const sb2 = sandbox();
updateState(sb2.ctx, (s) => { s.lastSeen = Date.now(); });
cpSync(join(sb2.ctx.stateDir, "state.json"), join(out, "state-minimal.json"));
updateState(sb2.ctx, () => {});
cpSync(join(sb2.ctx.stateDir, "state.json"), join(out, "state-noop-empty.json"));

// journal
journal(ctx, "tidy: fixed 2 links");
journal(ctx, "save failed <bad> & \"quoted\"   é 🚚", true);
journal(ctx, "plain", false);
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "journal.jsonl"), join(out, "journal.jsonl"));

writeJson(join(ctx.stateDir, "links.json"), ["/h/.config/a", "/h/.zshrc"]);
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "links.json"), join(out, "links.json"));
writeJson(join(ctx.stateDir, "links.json"), []);
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "links.json"), join(out, "links-empty.json"));
writeJson(join(ctx.stateDir, "secrets.json"), { "zeta/key": { plain: "a".repeat(64), age: "b".repeat(64) }, "alpha.env": { plain: "c".repeat(64), age: "d".repeat(64) } });
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "secrets.json"), join(out, "secrets.json"));
snooze(ctx, "link:/h/.zshrc", 7); snooze(ctx, "a-first", 7);
cpSync(join(ctx.stateDir, "snooze.json"), join(out, "snooze.json"));

const item = (level: string): any => ({ level });
for (const [name, items] of [["none", []], ["one", [item("info")]], ["three-urgent", [item("urgent"), item("info"), item("urgent")]]] as const) {
  writeCache(ctx, items as any);
  cpSync(join(ctx.cacheDir, "nudge"), join(out, `nudge-${name}`));
  cpSync(join(ctx.cacheDir, "count"), join(out, `count-${name}`));
}
sb.cleanup(); sb2.cleanup();
